definition: Joint tax return (i.e., married filing jointly filing status) is a single tax return filed by a married couple that had married before the end of the tax year, on which they report their combined income, credits, exemptions and deductions. A couple is allowed to file a joint tax return only if the state they reside in recognizes the relationship as a legal marriage. A couple may benefit from filing jointly as it may result in a more favorable tax bracket when one spouse earns less than another.
